title: Atomic transfer
contract: Reject insufficient funds or injected failure without changes; otherwise transfer amount and preserve total.
scope: Balances 0..3, amount 0..4, injected failure boolean; mathematical integers.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: Failure leaves both balances unchanged; success debits and credits exactly amount without negative balances.

variants.description: Debit before injected failure without rollback.
